description: Finds BuildBatch's guides for a decorating or flooring question (how long between coats, how many tiles in a square metre, what to buy to lay laminate), and returns up to three with each guide's own short answers and its address. It does not work out quantities for a room.

examples.query: How long between coats of paint?

name: find_guide

api.description: On a refusal of an argument: "buildbatch-assistant".

guides.description: Up to three guides, best first.

answers.description: The guide's own short answers, as published.

note.description: Whose answers they are and how far they have been checked, or that no guide matched.

ok.description: true: the guides were searched (none may match). false: the query was refused.

title: Find a BuildBatch guide
